content: Yihudape Yida Nabe
Heko, Iyorbaami yarsho shiishanaw yarsho bessa matan eqidashin, Goday kiitida, Xoossa asi gidida issi nabey Yihudape yis.

Goday kiittin he yarsho bessa bolla haysada yaagidi waassis; “Yarsho bessaw, yarsho bessaw, Goday neeko yaagees. Heko, Dawita keethaas Iyosyaasa geetetiya issi na7i yeletana. He na7ay ha77i haysan dhoqa yarsho bessan yarshishe de7iya kahineta ne bolla yarshana; asaa meqethaa ne bolla xuuggana” yaagis.
He gallas Xoossa addey haysada yaagidi malaata immis; “Goday odida malaatay haysa; Heko, ha yarsho bessay phalqetana; iya bolla de7iya bidoy laaletana” yaagis.

Kawoy Iyorbaami Xoossa addey Beetelen de7iya yarsho bessa bolla waassida waasuwa si7ida wode yarsho bessaafe ba kushiya mallidi, “He addiya oykite!” yaagis. Shin I, addiya mallida kushey bessan melidi attin, ba kushiya guye zaaridi ekanaw danda7ibeenna.
Xoossa addey Godaa qaalan immida malaatan yarsho bessay phalqetidi wodhin, iya bolla de7iya bidoyka laaletis.
Kawoy Iyorbaami Xoossa addiya, “Ta kushey kaseysada hanana mela taw gaannata; Godaa ne Xoossaa woossa” yaagis. Xoossa addey kawas gaannatidi Godaa woossin, kawa kushey simmidi kaseysada hanis.
Kawoy nabiyako, “Taara ta soo yedha; kathi ma; ta new imota immana” yaagis.
Shin Xoossaa addey, “Hari attoshin neeni ne aquwape baggaa taw immiyakoka, taani neera biike; haysan kathi miike, haathe uyike.
Godaa qaalay, ‘Neeni kathi moopa, haathe uyopa, ne yida ogiyara simmada boopa’ yaagis gidi kawas zaaris.”
Hessa gisho, I hara ogera bis; I Beetele yida ogiyara simmidi bibeenna.
He wode Beetelen issi cima nabey de7ees. He gallas Xoossaa addey Beetelen oothidaba ubbaa he cima addiya nayti yidi iyaw odidosona. Qassi he addey kawas odida qaala enti banta aawas odidosona.
Aaway, “I awu baggara bidee?” yaagin, Yihudape yida Xoossa addey bida ogiya mallidosona.
I ba naytako “Taw elle hare koorite” yaagin, enti iyaw hare koorin toggis.
Xoossa addiya geedo kaallidi bis. Issi wolaa kuyan uttidaysa demmidi, “Yihudape yida Xoossa addey nenee?” yaagidi oychis. Addey, “Ee tana” yaagis.
Cima nabey, “Kathi maanaw taara ta soo yedha” yaagis.
Xoossa addey zaaridi, “Taani guye simmada neera baanaw woyko ha bessan neera kathi maanaw woyko haathe uyanaw danda7ike.
Godaa qaalay taako ‘Neeni he bessan kathi moopa, haathe uyopa, ne yida ogiyara simmada boopa’ yaagis” yaagis.
Cima nabey, “Taka needa nabe. Goday kiitida kiitanchoy taako, ‘Kathi maana melanne haathe uyana mela iya zaarada neera ne soo ekada ya’ ” yaagis. Shin cima addey iyaw wordo odis.
Hessa gisho, Xoossa addey simmidi iyara iya soo bidi misinne uyis.
Enti gayta bolla uttidashin, Godaa qaalay iya guye zaarida ehida cima nabiyako yis.
Yihudape yida Xoossa addiyas ba qaala dhoqu oothidi, “Goday haysada yaagees; ‘Neeni Godaa qaala kiitetabaaka; Goday ne Xoossay nena kiitida kiitaa naagabaaka.
He bessan moopa woyko uyopa’ gida bessaa guye simmada yan kathi madasa; haathe uyadasa. Hiza ne ahay ne aawata duufon moogetenna” yaagis.
Xoossa addey midi uyidi simmin iya guye zaaridi ehida cima nabey ba hariya iyaw kooris.
I ogiya bishin gaammoy keyidi iya wodhin, ahay ogiyan kundis; hareynne gaammoy nam7ay aha matan eqidosona.
Heko, he ogiyara aadhiya asay ahi ogen kundidaysanne gaammoy aha matan eqidysa be7idi, bidi cima nabey de7iya kataman odidosona.

Iya guye zaarida cima nabey hessa si7ida wode haysada yaagis; “Hessi Godaa qaalas kiitetonna ixida Xoossa addiya. Godaa qaalay iyaw koyrottidi odidaysada Goday gaammon iya gathis; yaatin, gaammoy iya mentherethidi wodhis” yaagis.
Hessafe guye, cima nabey ba nayta, “Taw hare koorite” yaagin enti iyaw hare kooridosona.
I keyidi biya wode ogiyan kundida aha, aha matan eqida hariyanne gaammuwa demmis. Gaammoy aha mibeenna woyko hariya menthibeenna.
Cima nabey Xoossa addiya aha denthidi, hariya zokon wothidi, yeekanawunne mooganaw guye ba katama ekidi bis.
Baw giigisidi wothida duufon aha moogis. Iyaw, “Ta ishaw taassa! ta ishaw taassa!” yaagidi yeekis.
Iya moogi simmidi ba naytako haysada yaagis; “Ta hayqiya wode Xoossa addey moogetida duufon tana moogite. Ta meqethaa iya meqethaa matan wothite.
Beetele kataman de7iya yarsho bessa bollanne Samaare kataman de7iya dhoqa goyinno bessata bolla Goday kiittin, he addey waassidi odida tinbitey tuma poletana” yaagis.
Hessi haninka Iyorbaami ba iita ogiyape simmibeenna. Dhoqa goyinno bessatas Leewe koche gidonna oonaka kahine oothidi shuumis. Kahine gidanaw koyiya oonaka dhoqa goyinno bessan shuumees.
Iyorbaama keetha asaa dhaysanawunne biitta bollafe quchanaw gathida nagaray hessa.
